instruction: Create a new mail folder called 'Work' under Local Folders in Thunderbird.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a new folder 'Work' under Local Folders. Evaluator closes Thunderbird to ensure filesystem is flushed, then lists files in the Local Folders mail directory to verify the 'Work' mbox file exists.
